journal_lines: Flash of yellow in the wall. Spent extra time here.
Dense rock, then yellow. Worth the work.
Glint in the torchlight. Took all of it.
Gold in the deepslate. Smaller vein but real.
The yellow stood out even without torchlight.
Two veins crossing at the base of the shaft. Both taken.
Gold just above the magma layer. The heat helped nothing.
Found it in the nether-adjacent stone. Dense.
Scattered nuggets along the crack, then the vein proper.
Thin but pure. No matrix mixed in.
The glint moved with the torch. Followed the torch.
Gold laced through the granite like stitching.
Ore thick enough to see from ten paces.
Single exposed face on the wall. Cleared it completely.
